svg.title: harmonic series on c2
svg.desc: The first sixteen harmonics of C2 on a bass and a treble stave, each labelled with its harmonic number and its deviation in cents from the nearest equal-tempered note. The seventh and fourteenth partials are 31 cents flat, the eleventh is 49 cents sharp, and the thirteenth is 41 cents sharp; the octaves and fifths are within a few cents.

g.text: Under each note: the harmonic number, then how far that harmonic falls from the nearest equal-tempered key, in cents.
